chapter: Jazz club letters and Dr. Sushan
title: Ed Marr's letter to Tom Brown's circle
summary: A letter signed Ed Marr asks about getting a picture of Tom Brown for a Look magazine story on New Orleans jazz.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: All right. This is the letter. The heading is... No dating on it. Dr. Edmond Sushant. No all names there.

Dear Stuart, thought you'd like a copy of these snaps. Do wish that I could get some together with you and Tom Brown some night soon. And deeply, as it says here, I am deeply regretful that you got away without playing a note last Saturday night, even though you gave me that, quote, I got a new horn and can't blow it yet, unquote. I was not going to let you get away without showing those guys, well, they call you Red Hot. That's underlined from I was not going down through Red Hot. Speak to Tom some night soon and ask him what would be convenient for them to get together some night next week, and I'll try to do my best to be right there. All right. Incidentally, we need a good picture of Tom in his prime as, quote, look, unquote, magazine, is here in town now and figures to run a story on New Orleans jazz. I told them what a great figure Tom was. Do you think he would spare me one for them? Best regards, Ed Marr.
